rapid_reentry.csv.note: Synthetic test dataset: 12 pairs of trades across 12 consecutive calendar dates (Sep 1-12, 2026). Each initial losing trade (-100) is followed 5 minutes later by a rapid re-entry (+50). Demonstrates timing pattern without implying loss causation.

high_activity.csv.note: Synthetic test dataset: 10 mock trading dates (Sep 1-10, 2026) testing activity detection. 8 normal winning days (2 trades/day, net +100) and 2 high-activity losing days (12 trades/day, net -1200). Dates represent test iterations, not real exchange days.

expiry_pattern.csv.note: Synthetic test dataset: 5 non-expiry winning trades (+100 each) and 5 expiry losing trades (-200 each). Tested as an observed association without claiming expiry caused the losses.

clean_trader.csv.note: Synthetic test dataset: One trade per day for 10 dates with alternating +50 and -50; no rapid re-entry, no high-activity days. Confirms zero false positive detections.

tiny_sample.csv.note: Synthetic test dataset: Exactly 8 trades (< 10 threshold) designed to trigger insufficient-data warnings.
